inputs.original_text: I can't believe what I'm hearing out of Indiana earlier this month. Some judge there went and blocked a law aimed at protecting unborn life, and now the ACLU along with this Hoosier Jews for Choice group is claiming the whole thing violates religious freedoms by burdening the ability to obtain an abortion in accordance with their sincerely held beliefs. They're calling it a big victory against forcing one narrow worldview on everyone, but that's just code for letting abortion activists hide behind religion to keep killing babies. Conservative outlets like LifeNews are right to call it what it is: this judge thinks killing babies in abortions is a religious right. It's the same old progressive push to undermine traditional family values, personal responsibility, and the basic authority of laws that respect the sanctity of life over radical reinterpretations of freedom.
inputs.modified_text: You won't believe this nonsense out of Indiana. A judge there just blocked a law meant to protect unborn life, and now the ACLU teamed up with Hoosier Jews for Choice to claim it violates their religious freedom to get abortions based on their so-called sincerely held beliefs. They're crowing about it as some big win against imposing one narrow worldview on everyone, but that's just a slick excuse for abortion activists to hide behind religion while they keep ending innocent lives. Conservative sources like LifeNews are calling it exactly right—the judge is treating the killing of babies in abortions as some kind of religious right. This is the usual progressive assault on our traditions, the authority of laws that uphold the sanctity of life, personal responsibility, and the family values that have held this country together for generations. It's time we pushed back hard against this erosion of moral order.
